pretend to be asleep: Whenever Mom came into the room to check on him, Tommy would close his eyes and pretend to be asleep.
每當媽媽進房查看他時，湯米就會閉上眼睛裝睡。
pretend not to notice: When my friend spilled juice on her dress at the party, I decided to pretend not to notice so she wouldn't feel embarrassed.
朋友在派對上把果汁灑在洋裝上時，我決定假裝沒注意，免得她覺得尷尬。
pretend to knowledge: My uncle does not pretend to knowledge of modern art, but he enjoys visiting museums on weekends.
我叔叔並不自稱有現代藝術的知識，但他喜歡週末去參觀博物館。
justice prevails: In most superhero movies, justice prevails in the end, and the bad guys are sent to prison.
在大多數超級英雄電影裡，正義最後得勝，壞人都被送進監獄。
prevail over the enemy: After three days of fierce fighting, the small army managed to prevail over the enemy and saved the city.
經過三天激烈的戰鬥，這支小軍隊終於戰勝敵人，拯救了這座城市。
the view prevails: In many small towns, the view prevails that young people should live close to their parents.
在許多小鎮，年輕人應該住在父母附近的看法盛行。
prevail upon someone: After weeks of begging, we finally managed to prevail upon my father to take a vacation and relax.
經過幾週的懇求，我們終於說服我父親去度個假放鬆一下。
prevailing winds: The prevailing winds in this area blow from the northeast in winter, so the beaches get very cold.
這個地區冬天的盛行風從東北方吹來，所以海灘會變得非常冷。
prevent disease: Washing your hands often is one of the simplest ways to prevent disease from spreading in schools.
勤洗手是預防疾病在校園傳播最簡單的方法之一。
prevent someone from: The heavy snow prevented us from driving up the mountain, so we stayed in the hotel all day.
大雪阻止我們開車上山，所以我們整天待在飯店裡。
prevent accidents: The city put up more traffic lights near the school to prevent accidents during rush hour.
市政府在學校附近增設更多紅綠燈，以防止尖峰時段發生意外。
prevent the spread: Wearing a mask on crowded buses can help prevent the spread of the flu during the winter months.
在擁擠的公車上戴口罩，有助於在冬季阻止流感蔓延。
prey on the weak: Bullies often prey on the weak, so teachers should pay attention to students who are always alone.
霸凌者常常欺凌弱者，所以老師應該留意總是獨自一人的學生。
prey on one's mind: The mistake I made during the final exam kept preying on my mind all weekend.
我在期末考犯的那個錯誤，整個週末都讓我掛心。
prey on tourists: Pickpockets often prey on tourists in crowded night markets, so keep your wallet in a safe place.
扒手常在擁擠的夜市專騙觀光客，所以要把錢包放在安全的地方。
fall prey to: Many old people fall prey to phone scams because they trust callers who say they are from the bank.
許多老人淪為電話詐騙的犧牲品，因為他們相信自稱是銀行人員的來電者。
price a product: It is not easy to price a product correctly, because if it costs too much, nobody will buy it.
要為產品正確定價並不容易，因為如果價格太高，就沒有人會買。
be priced out of the market: If our coffee costs twice as much as other shops', we will be priced out of the market very soon.
如果我們的咖啡價格是其他店的兩倍，我們很快就會因太貴被市場排除。
price oneself out: The famous designer charged so much for his work that he began to price himself out of many projects.
那位知名設計師收費太高，開始因定價過高失去許多案子的客戶。
at any price: The rich collector said he wanted the rare painting at any price, even if it cost him millions.
那位富有的收藏家說他不惜任何代價都要得到這幅稀有的畫，即使要花上好幾百萬。
prize freedom above all: People who once lived under a strict government often prize freedom above all and fight hard to keep it.
曾經生活在嚴苛政府統治下的人，往往最珍視自由，並努力奮鬥以保有它。
a prized possession: This old guitar from my grandfather is a prized possession, so I never let anyone else play it.
這把祖父留下的舊吉他是我的珍藏，所以我從不讓別人彈。
prize open the door: The firefighters used a metal bar to prize open the door and rescue the family trapped inside.
消防員用一根鐵棒撬開門，救出受困在裡面的一家人。
highly prized: Fresh mountain tea from this area is highly prized, and a small box can cost several thousand dollars.
這個地區的新鮮高山茶備受珍視，一小盒就要價好幾千元。
probe the cause: A team of experts was sent to probe the cause of the plane crash and find out what went wrong.
一組專家被派去探究空難的原因，查明哪裡出了問題。
probe into one's past: The reporter began to probe into the singer's past and discovered that she had grown up very poor.
記者開始深究那位歌手的過去，發現她從小家境非常貧窮。
probe for weaknesses: During the first half, our team carefully probed for weaknesses in the other team's defense.
上半場時，我們隊仔細探查對方防守的弱點。
a police probe: A police probe into the missing money showed that two staff members had secretly stolen it.
警方對失竊款項的調查顯示，有兩名員工暗中偷走了這筆錢。
